# m68k, Motorola syntax, against `vasmm68k_mot -no-opt -devpac` (a 68000).
#
# vasm is the secondary reference. With `-no-opt` it keeps every absolute
# address and displacement at the size it would use for an unknown value, so
# only cases with no size choice belong here: registers, explicit `.w`/`.l`,
# addresses beyond 16 bits, and non-zero displacements. What it adds is
# confirmation of the places rsasm deliberately parts from GNU as: no
# instruction substitution, Motorola's word-sized default index, and `8(pc)`
# as an address.
#
# Also left out: a negative byte immediate. The CPU ignores the high byte of
# its word; GNU as fills it with the sign (`#-1` is `ffff`), vasm with zero
# (`00ff`), and rsasm follows GNU as.

# ---- the Amiga DMACON idiom ----
 move.w #$7fff,$DFF096
 move.w #$8200,$dff096

# ---- no instruction substitution ----
 move.l #1,d0
 move.l #-1,d0
 move.l #0,d0
 move.l #1,d7
 add.w #1,d0
 add.l #1,d0
 add.w #8,d0
 add.w #9,d0
 sub.l #1,d0
 add.l #1,a0
 sub.w #2,a1
 cmp.w #1,d0
 cmp.l #0,d0
 cmp.b #$ff,d0
 and.w #1,d0
 or.w #1,d0
 or.l #$80000000,d3

# ---- Motorola's default index size is a word ----
 move.w 8(a0,d1),d0
 lea 4(a1,a2),a3
 move.l (a0,d1),d0
 move.w 8(pc,d0),d1

# ---- `(pc)` and `8(pc)` name an address ----
 move.w 8(pc),d0
 move.w (8,pc),d0
 jmp (4,pc)
 move.w (8,pc,d0.w),d0
 btst #1,4(pc)
 movem.l 4(pc),d0

# ---- single-operand register shift, and `shs`/`slo` ----
 asl d0
 lsr.l d1
 shs d0
 slo d0

# ---- addressing modes ----
 move.w d1,d0
 move.w a1,d0
 move.w (a1),d0
 move.w (a1)+,d0
 move.w -(a1),d0
 move.w 4(a1),d0
 move.w -4(a1),d0
 move.w 4(a1,d2.w),d0
 move.w 4(a1,d2.l),d0
 move.w (a1,d2.w),d0
 move.w $400.w,d0
 move.w $400.l,d0
 move.w #1234,d0
 move.l d0,-(sp)
 move.l (sp)+,d0
 move.l d0,32767(a6)
 move.l d0,10(a5,d3.w)
 move.l d0,$12345678
 move.w ($400).w,d0

# ---- data movement ----
 move.b d0,d1
 move.b #$ff,d0
 move.w #'AB',d0
 move.l #'ABCD',d0
 move.l d0,a0
 move.w d0,a0
 movea.l d0,a0
 movea.w (a0),a1
 moveq #1,d0
 moveq #-128,d0
 moveq #127,d7
 move sr,d0
 move d0,sr
 move.w #$2700,sr
 move #0,ccr
 move usp,a0
 move a0,usp
 movem.l d0-d3/a0-a2,-(sp)
 movem.l (sp)+,d0-d3/a0-a2
 movem.l d0,-(sp)
 movem.w d0/d2/a5,(a0)
 movem.l 8(a0),d0-a6
 movem.l #$0003,(a0)
 movem.l a0-a1/d0-d1,(a0)
 movem.l d0-d7/a0-a7,-(sp)
 lea (a0),a1
 lea 4(a0),a1
 lea $400.w,a1
 lea $12345678,a1
 pea (a0)
 pea 4(a0)
 exg d0,d1
 exg a0,a1
 exg a1,d0
 swap d0
 clr.b d0
 clr.w (a0)
 clr.l -(a0)
 ext.w d0
 ext.l d0

# ---- arithmetic and logic ----
 add.b d0,d1
 add.w (a0),d1
 add.l d0,(a0)
 add.l d0,a0
 add.w #1,(a0)
 adda.w #1,a0
 addi.b #1,d0
 addi.l #1,-(sp)
 addq.w #1,d0
 addq.l #8,a0
 subq.b #8,d7
 addx.b d0,d1
 addx.l -(a0),-(a1)
 subx.w -(a0),-(a1)
 sub.l a0,a1
 subi.w #1,4(a0)
 cmpa.l a0,a1
 cmpi.b #1,d0
 cmpm.b (a0)+,(a1)+
 cmp.b (a0),d0
 andi.w #1,(a0)
 ori.l #1,d0
 eori.b #1,(a0)
 eor.l d0,d1
 eor.w #1,d0
 and.w d0,(a0)
 or.l (a0)+,d0
 not.b d0
 neg.l d0
 negx.w d0
 abcd -(a0),-(a1)
 sbcd d0,d1
 nbcd (a0)
 mulu d0,d1
 muls.w #3,d1
 divu d0,d1
 divs.w #3,d1
 tst.b d0
 tst.w (a0)
 tas (a0)
 chk d0,d1

# ---- shifts and bits ----
 asl.w #8,d1
 asr.w d1,d0
 lsl.w 4(a0)
 lsr.b #2,d0
 rol.w (a0)+
 ror.b #8,d0
 roxl.b d0,d1
 roxr.w $1234.w
 btst #3,d0
 btst d1,(a0)
 btst d0,#5
 bset #7,d0
 bclr #0,(a0)+
 bchg d0,d1
 seq d0
 sne (a0)
 st d0

# ---- control ----
 jmp (a0)
 jmp 4(a0)
 jmp $400.w
 jsr -198(a6)
 jsr $12345678
 rts
 rte
 rtr
 trap #15
 trapv
 link a6,#-4
 unlk a6
 nop
 reset
 stop #$2700
 illegal
 andi #$f8ff,sr
 andi #$fe,ccr
 ori #$0700,sr
 eori #1,ccr
 dc.b "a""b",0
 dc.b "text",0
 dc.b 'it''s',0
